name: Kirabaru Shiiko
source:
A third-year student at the school.
On the surface, she is a female student who belongs to the Marine Sports Club.

Behind her back, she is a member of the Ookumiza.

Among them, she is one of the shrine maidens (yuta) who serve the protagonist, Ichito, and is a close aide to the king.

Possessing a commensurate amount of dragon power (seji), Shioko can freely control fire.

She speaks in a dignified, masculine tone.
She is earnest, honest, and pure, but also inflexible and rigid, which can cause trouble for Ichito even without her realizing it.
